what: Vertical panels of the same width (270px) stand in a row and only the center panel scales to 320/270, with 25px beside it (center-gap) and 25px between the other panels (gap). Every 10 seconds the next panel comes to the center, each panel closing 10% of the remaining distance per frame from its current spot to its target (a lerp with no curve), so it starts fast and stops slowly. The center panel gets is-active (the rest are faded to .15 as in the original — CSS’s job), and the prev/next buttons and page dots also move it. It loops endlessly (panels more than half the panel count away jump to the opposite side)

options.every: Interval to the next slide (seconds), default 10 — 0 turns off auto-advance
options.scale: Center panel scale, default 1.185 (320/270) — news row 600/270, video row 320/196
options.center-gap: Gap between the center panel and side panels (px), default 25 — news row 182
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Row where panels are stacked (sets the height)
options.[data-fx-part=prev]·[data-fx-part=next]·: (if any) prev · next · dots — one dot per panel
options.--fx-s: (The part writes the current scale on each panel) To keep text inside a panel at its own size, undo it with scale: calc(1 / var(--fx-s, 1)) — news row title and date
options.pause: On hover, auto-advance pauses while the hand is over it and counts again from the start on release — media-brand selected news row
options.swipe: Drag-to-flip threshold finger mouse (px) — for a finger the distance moved at release, for a mouse the amount moved in one go while pressed (movementX), past it, one panel turns (original custom-slider 50 15). When given, data-drag·touch-action pan-y are applied to the whole part (dragging works even if the press cell covers the panel), and the one click right after a drag is swallowed (media-brand picked News row — draggable on wide screens too). Default is no drag
options.sp-swipe: The same values as swipe, only below 1024px (media-brand Hero · video row: 50 15 — on wide screens the press cell covers the panel so it can’t be dragged)
